data.name: Workday vs POMS value match
data.check: Order number exists in POMS and invoice subtotal (excl. VAT) equals POMS gross_taxable_amount. Skipped for prepayments, delivery notes and credit notes, and superseded by NO21-004 once an NGA tracker response exists

data.name: Related party revenue category
data.condition: Bill-To or Sold-To is Ziklo Bank or Volvo Bank (customer.related_party) AND line description contains 'Brand'
data.remediation: Manually correct the revenue category to 3030.

data.name: NGA tracker captured
data.check: A tracker row exists for the invoice with invoice_number, customer_id, model_number, total_invoice_price, gross_taxable_amount and base_price populated

data.name: NGA response received
data.condition: NGA customer with a tracker row

data.name: Fee lines removed when instructed
data.check: No line whose revenue category is a fee category (3041, 3042, 3043)

data.name: Revised gross and base applied
data.check: Invoice taxable amount = revised_gross_amount; vehicle line unit price = revised_base_price

data.name: Factoring payment captured
data.condition: A payment is applied to the invoice as ON_ACCOUNT
data.check: payment_id exists in the factoring tracker

data.name: Leasing licence plate
data.condition: Bill-To is LeasePlan, Arval, Leasys, Locarent or Kinto (customer.leasing_plate_required)
data.check: Vehicle line description contains the POMS license_plate

data.name: Personal loan bill-to
data.condition: POMS financing_type = PERSONAL_LOAN and partner is not Banco BPI SA

data.name: Banco BPI exception
data.condition: POMS financing partner = Banco BPI SA

data.name: VAT number on extras / prepayment
data.condition: document_kind is Sales Invoice Extra or prepayment

data.name: E&Y final invoice match
data.condition: An E&Y final invoice exists for the Workday invoice
data.check: invoice_date, customer name, PO number, VIN, amount excl. VAT and total all equal

data.name: Gapless numbering and approval order
data.condition: Statutory invoice types PRT Invoice / Credit note - EY
data.check: Workday statutory number equals the E&Y number; an APPROVED invoice must have an E&Y final invoice

data.name: Exclude internal zero-value documents
data.condition: Delivery Note or Sales Invoice Extra with zero value
data.check: Flag as excluded from the daily E&Y report

data.name: SharePoint tracker adjustments applied
data.condition: Bill-To customer.sharepoint_tracker = true and a tracker row exists for the POMS order
data.check: po_number = required_po_reference; vehicle unit price = agreed_unit_price; description contains required_description_text
